description: Returns one scene cue from a Plot Speaks mystery or adventure script, as text: a READ ALOUD part (the scene as spoken narration) and, where the cue has them, NARRATOR NOTES that are not meant to be read aloud because they would spoil the scene; cue S1 also lists the follow-up cues to listen for. With a play id it records the scene reached as an anonymous play event, which the play's watch page shows as a timeline. An unknown slug returns an error naming the available stories; a cue id the story lacks returns an error saying so (or that the story has no cues).

cue.description: The cue id as written in the story's script: S, a number and an optional letter; the S and case may be omitted. E.g. S1, S3b or 3b

play_id.description: The play id start_story returned, e.g. 3f2b8c1e-9d4a-4e7b-a1c2-5b6d7e8f9a0b; when given, the cue is logged against that play

slug.description: The story slug or title, e.g. example-dinner-party

name: get_cue
title: Get a scene cue
